set.body:
Defect: First contact between the profile format and 23 sheets of measured hazards. The plan names P2b-ii/P2c as its riskiest slice -- expect P2c to force profile-schema changes that P4 was budgeted for.

Do: Friends CorpusProfile as DATA under the git-ignored data root, never in Git: the source set's admission state is `proposed` and the owner unstaged the intake on 2026-09-17. Run CorpusReader.open over it.

Tests: The synthetic fixtures and the real run CANNOT share a profile file (the real one is not in Git) -- say how the two are kept in step, or the fixtures drift from the thing they model.

Exit: A real run reproduces the measured Friends counts (52 events, 30 scenes, 2 episodes, 630 recall units, 23 participant sheets, 27,777 content-bearing rows) in a CONTENT-FREE receipt. No participant prose or stimulus transcript leaves the data root.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-17-annotation-intake-contract.md S3, P2c
set.title: intake P2c: Friends profile and the first real run
